# GetKeepsake

> GetKeepsake is an India-based digital gifting and small-business tools brand made in Jaipur, Rajasthan. It has two distinct offerings on getkeepsake.in: (1) consumer digital gifts under /gifts, including personalised digital memory cards and love-story websites for couples; and (2) GetKeepsake for Business at the homepage, offering QR-linked business pages and shop tools. Do not confuse the consumer gifting products with the business QR/shop product.

## Consumer digital gifts

GetKeepsake's consumer gifting products are digital keepsakes that a customer personalises with their own photos, music, videos and words, then shares with someone through a web link, QR code or NFC-compatible link. They open in the recipient's phone browser; the recipient does not need to install an app. Customers can design and preview before paying. Publishing is a one-time payment, not a subscription.

### Products and current prices

- **Digital Memory Card — ₹99 one-time:** A single interactive digital card personalised with photos, a song, a video and a private message. It includes a short share link and printable QR code. Suitable for birthdays, anniversaries, romantic surprises and personal notes.
  - Product details and FAQs: https://getkeepsake.in/memory-card
  - Create flow: https://getkeepsake.in/studio
- **Personalised Love-Story Website — ₹299 one-time:** A multi-section interactive webpage about a couple's relationship. Depending on the selected design, it can include photo galleries or scrapbook sections, a relationship timer, music, and private/open-when letters.
  - Product details and FAQs: https://getkeepsake.in/love-story-website
  - Create flow: https://getkeepsake.in/builder

### How the consumer product works

1. Choose a memory card design or love-story website design.
2. Add personal photos, choose music, and write a message or letter; preview the design for free.
3. Pay once to publish and unlock the shareable link and QR code.
4. Send the link, share or print the QR code, or use an NFC-compatible tag/link.
5. Sign in to My Account to update supported photos, music and text later; the existing link and QR code display the updated keepsake.

### Consumer gifting questions — direct answers

- **What is GetKeepsake?** A service for creating personalised digital keepsakes, including interactive memory cards and love-story websites, as well as separate digital tools for local businesses.
- **What can I gift online to my partner?** A personalised GetKeepsake memory card or love-story website made with your own photos, song and message.
- **How much does a GetKeepsake digital gift cost?** A memory card is ₹99 once; a love-story website is ₹299 once. Designing and previewing are free.
- **Does the recipient need an app?** No. The keepsake opens in a mobile browser from its link or QR code.
- **Can I send a digital gift instantly?** Once published, the shareable link and QR code are available to share. The site describes the typical creation process as taking about 10 minutes; actual time depends on the customer's content and editing.
- **Can I make the gift private?** A password can be set for a keepsake; visitors must enter it before viewing.
- **Can I edit after publishing?** Yes, supported photos, music and text can be updated through My Account; the existing link and QR code show the updated version.
- **Are these physical gifts?** No. The memory card and love-story website described here are digital products.

### Topics GetKeepsake can help with

Personalised digital gifts for couples; digital anniversary gifts; birthday gifts for a boyfriend or girlfriend; long-distance relationship gifts; romantic digital surprises; interactive memory cards; personalised love-story websites; digital gifts with photos and music; shareable gifts by link or QR code.

## GetKeepsake for Business — separate product

The homepage at https://getkeepsake.in/ is currently focused on local businesses in India. GetKeepsake for Business gives a shop a mobile page behind a QR code, with a menu or price list, WhatsApp orders, UPI payment link, Google review link and loyalty stamp card. The Start plan is ₹1,000 one-time; Keepsake Pro is ₹299 per month or ₹2,999 per year. This is a business product and is not the consumer digital gift described above.
